summary: Verified approval-alert feature end-to-end at API+contract level. POST /api/admin/people/merchant/{uid}/review {decision:'approve'} and /partner equivalent each create an in-app notification with title containing 'Approved', body containing 'Tap to log in', data.type='account_approved', data.role='merchant'|'partner' as required. SSE emit shape (type='notification', payload.type='account_approved', payload.role=...) matches what web_panel RealtimeContext and provider ChatNotifier listeners expect, so client auto-refresh/redirect will trigger. Rejection path still fires 'Action Needed' (regression intact). Push delivery (webpush/fcm/expo) is attempted inside notify() under try/except — no device tokens in this env but no errors raised. Both web shells (/api/panel/ and /api/provider/) return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: notification_service.notify() correctly forwards data.type into SSE payload via `type: data.get('type') or event`, so RealtimeContext filter `d?.type !== 'account_approved'` works. Confirmed.
partner_reg_service.admin_approve_kyc passes `_data: {type: account_approved, role: partner}` through ctx; template_service.fire_event spreads `ctx._data` into notify data param — chain is intact.
people_admin_service.review_person for partners WITHOUT a partner_profiles doc falls back to direct notify() with the correct data payload — covers seeded partners too.
No real-device push verification possible without expo/fcm tokens in this env; code paths are guarded with try/except so a missing provider cannot break approval.
